_about: MISSING PIECES (Dom, Oct 23 2026): the one or two pieces that would push each Dark Knight team over the top. Not a filter - the Scout still shows everything it finds; a find at one of these positions gets tagged 'fills a missing piece'. Short on purpose; reviewed each week. pos = the Yahoo positions that would fill it.

DK I.piece: A third wide receiver you can start every week
DK I.why: Pickens, London and Diggs are the only real receivers, and Diggs is the fill-in when Pickens is off (Week 14)

DK II.why: Braelon Allen drops to about 8 a game once Breece Hall is back, and Etienne's return splits the Saints backs

DK II.piece: A wide receiver for Week 10 on
DK II.why: Germie Bernard's role shrinks when Michael Pittman returns; McConkey is the bet if he clears his concussion

DK III.piece: A lead running back - save the $91 for him
DK III.why: Every back is a fill-in: Bam Knight until Love returns, Pierce until Barkley does, White until Croskey-Merritt does, Perine in a split

DK IV.why: Jefferson dips once Jordan Addison is back, Downs fades when Alec Pierce returns, and Flowers is off in Week 13
